out.title: Noel N. Tata retires as Director and Vice-Chairman
out.summary: Mr. Noel N. Tata will retire as Non-Executive, Non-Independent Director and Vice-Chairman of Titan Company effective 12 November 2026, in accordance with Tata Group Governance Guidelines.

person.name: Noel N. Tata
person.bio: Vice-Chairman of Titan Company; retiring per Tata Group Governance Guidelines. No further background provided in the filing.
